messages:
jess: quick one: for auto-fallback UX do we expose separate p95 / error% fields or a single safety slider?
ryan: separate. SREs treat them differently.
priya: separate + presets (low/balanced/high) for product teams. advanced collapsed.
ajess: proposed hosted defaults p95=400ms, err=1%.
alex: per-route presets needed (chat vs embeddings).
ryan: also be explicit which errors count (5xx, timeouts, model-reject). list in UI.
jess: yes — users must know what triggers match.
priya: feature: preview panel showing estimated switch % based on sampled telemetry (24-72h).
ops-bot: warning: full scans are heavy. recommend sample_pct=5% for preview.
mira: audit sampling defaults: auto-fallback=1%, canary=10%. show cost estimate badge.
ryan: add "capture payload for replay" toggle off by default for hosted. privacy badge if enabled.
priya: operator override flow: require reason + optional TTL, record audit event. show undo for 5m.
ajess: hysteresis: min_switch_interval=5m, debounce_ms=90000, exponential backoff on repeats. show state machine graphic.
alex: expression rule authoring: builder (status, msg_contains, latency_gt) + live match preview.
ryan: sandbox expressions, limit regex complexity. tag matched rule id in events for debugging.
ops-bot: tagging increases event size (~+8%). surface tradeoff.
mira: playback API: GET /api/v1/rollouts/{id}/playback?from=&to=&sample_pct=. require operator role, log access.
priya: simulate preview with dry-run param.
jess: summary: UI = two inputs + preset dropdown, advanced rule builder, preview sim, hysteresis controls, audit toggles, override UX, cost/privacy badges. i'll mock tomorrow.
ryan: i'll draft API stub and migration notes for old configs.
priya: i'll update runbook checklist + docs text.
ops-bot: scheduled: prototype review 10:30am PT tomorrow.
mira: I'll load-test sampler @5% over 72h on staging.
jess: thanks team :tada:
